definitions.explanation: The American online retailer, one of the most used shopping sites in Japan. アマゾンで{買|か}う (to buy on Amazon) is an everyday phrase.
The Amazon River in South America and the rainforest around it; the river itself is アマゾン{川|がわ}.

examples.english: I bought a book on Amazon.

examples.japanese: アマゾン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}したら→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: I ordered it on Amazon and it arrived the next day.
These days I buy everything on Amazon, so I hardly go to the shops in my neighborhood.

examples.japanese: アマゾン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{熱帯雨林|ねったいうりん}→熱帯雨林：19014_nettaiurin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
アマゾン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{失|うしな}われている→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: Every year a large area of the Amazon forest is lost.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- アマゾン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ / ⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to buy / order on Amazon
- アマゾン{川|がわ}: the Amazon River
- アマゾン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{熱帯雨林|ねったいうりん}→熱帯雨林：19014_nettaiurin⟧: the Amazon rainforest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{楽天|らくてん}→楽天：33805_rakuten⟧: Rakuten — the main Japanese online shopping mall and Amazon's chief rival in Japan
- ⟦{通販|つうはん}→通販：17464_tsuuhan⟧: mail-order and online shopping in general
